notice.title: 1650 Public Notice: Rescheduling of Joint CSIR - UGC NET Examination (for Chemical Sciences and Mathematical Sciences) in Tamil Nadu & Puducherry which were postponed Read More

exam_date.evidence: The Joint CSIR-UGC NET Examination for the Subjects Chemical Sciences and Mathematical Sciences scheduled on 26 November 2020 (but postponed owing to Cyclone "Nivar") is re-scheduled for all Examination Centres in the Union Territory of Pud

admit_card_from.evidence: The revised Admit Card shall also be uploaded by 28 November 2020 (Saturday) after 05:00 P.M
